NBA Hang Time.name: NBA Hangtime
NBA Hang Time.summary: Hangtime was the third basketball game by the original development team behind the NBA Jam series. The title was changed due to the NBA Jam name being acquired by Acclaim Entertainment, the publisher of the games for the home market. Acclaim's NBA Jam Extreme was released the same year as Hangtime. Features introduced in Hangtime included character creation, alley oops and double dunks. A software update known as NBA Maximum Hangtime was released for the arcades later in the life cycle.

Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV - Wall.name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV: Wall of Fire
Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV - Wall.summary: Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV Wall of Fire is a gripping strategy simulation set in ancient China. Devise strategies against foreign rulers and take control of their cities to grow your own empire.
